steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Choose Your Ground
steps.body:
Before the fight begins, you can position your heroes on the battlefield. Defenders up front absorb hits, while ranged heroes deal damage safely from the back.

Click a hero portrait, then click an empty tile to move them. Click two heroes to swap their positions.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Fog of War
steps.body:
The enemy half of the field is hidden until you confirm your positions and the battle begins. Once you're satisfied with your formation, hit Start Battle.

Placement matters — heroes closer to the front will be targeted first by melee enemies.
